limitations: Candidate whole-image AI-generation detector; it is not a face-swap specialist or an authentication method.
Not evaluated on the Pratyaksh held-out dataset; the score is not a calibrated probability of authenticity.
The method can miss unseen generators and can flag genuine images after resizing, compression or editing.
The complete image is center-cropped to 224 x 224 using the official evaluation preprocessing; no region is localized.
detector_signals.observation: Day 2-3 candidate image model ran; project validation is required.
detector_signals.scope: Whole decoded image; no region localization

score.interpretation: Sigmoid classifier output, not probability that evidence is fake

limitations: Research-only candidate; its checkpoint licence does not permit commercial use.
The SBI checkpoint was trained on FaceForensics++ c23 and can miss unseen manipulation methods.
YuNet replaces the RetinaFace extractor used in the original SBI evaluation, so project evaluation is required.
A low signal is not proof that a face is genuine; compression, scaling and small faces can remove forensic traces.
Fine-tuned on cleaned still-image face crops; test coverage was 68.5%. Multi-face maximum-score decisions were not evaluated.
Related identities across splits remain unverified, and the test sample was reused for model comparisons.
detector_signals.observation: No face was detected; no face-forgery score was produced.
detector_signals.scope: YuNet-detected face crops; maximum face signal reported

integrity.limitations: Hash chaining detects edits against a retained anchor. A privileged attacker can rewrite the entire chain unless an external anchor is retained.
integrity.log_scope: Provenance intake, analysis and export events. Operational case activity is maintained separately.
integrity.storage: Original files stored read-only, keyed by SHA-256.

limitations: Connections describe matching content. They do not identify an original uploader or establish editing order.
A visual match can involve shared background or objects; it does not authenticate a face.
No match means this method found insufficient support, rather than proving the files are unrelated.
Metadata can be changed or stripped. Recorded device and software names are unverified claims.
Credentials describe signed assertions. Signature validity, content binding and signer trust are reported separately.
Recompression, screenshots and heavy edits can strip metadata and weaken matching.
Difference overlays include alignment error, compression and lighting changes as well as possible edits.
This report supports evidence-handling review. It provides no legal admissibility decision.
